summary: Frontend E2E testing of the Website Widget feature (list, editor Look/Doors/Routing/Install tabs, live preview iframe, public /api/w/<key>/demo embed, and Tools>Leads regression tile). All core flows work end-to-end. Manager qa-manager@invalid.imonsocial.test authenticated OK, editor loads for widget 6ab72996c248f5420bf0a14a (key cTxlgGYS). Save persists across a navigate-away/back reload. Public demo bubble renders, Text-us form submission shows 'Check your phone' success state with zero network POST (preview mode). No blocking bugs found.
verified_flows: Login as manager -> /home -> in-app pushState to /admin/website-widget loads (data-testid=widgets-header) with 1 card widget-card-6ab72996c248f5420bf0a14a showing 'Text us' + 'Call me now' door indicators.

Tap card -> editor URL /admin/website-widget/<id>; widget-editor-header + tabs widget-tab-look/doors/routing/install all present; widget-preview + widget-preview-frame iframe render; iframe src = /api/w/cTxlgGYS/demo?v=0&c=<base64> and inside the frame the bubble panel is auto-open showing 'How can we help?' with both doors.

Look tab: typing #DC2626 into widget-bubble-color-hex + tapping widget-position-left + widget-icon-phone + editing widget-label to 'Chat with us' + tapping Save shows toast; iframe reloads and the .imosw-head background computes to rgb(220,38,38). Quick swatch widget-bubble-color-quick-DC2626 and widget-label-on toggle present.

Persistence: after pushState away and back, widget-bubble-color-hex=#DC2626 and widget-label='Chat with us' (GET /api/widgets/<id> confirms appearance.bubble_color=#DC2626, label='Chat with us', position=left, icon=phone).
Match my website: widget-site-url + widget-match-site-btn -> widget-bubble-color-site-swatches renders and bubble color updates (no crash).

Doors tab: widget-door-text-on / widget-door-call-on toggles present; editing widget-call-label to 'Ring me now' + widget-copy-title 'How can we help you today?' -> Save; preview head text updates to the new title within ~1s.

Routing tab: 9 ring-group members (inbox-member-*) with toggles; widget-ring-seconds-plus / -minus clamp to 15..90 (verified by 30x minus -> 15s and 40x plus -> 90s); widget-hours-store/-always chips, widget-send-from-store_line/-rep_line chips, widget-inbox-* rows (2 inboxes shown for store_line), widget-method-round_robin/jump_ball/weighted_round_robin chips, widget-intake-text field all render and Save persists (verified via GET /api/widgets/<id>).

Install tab: widget-install-status text visible ('Not seen on a website yet'); widget-snippet contains <script src="https://app.imonsocial.com/api/w/cTxlgGYS.js" async></script>; widget-copy-snippet click -> 'Install code copied' toast with clipboard permission granted; widget-domains input, widget-section-stats tiles (Page loads / Opened / Leads / Texts / Call requests / Avg. to connect) and widget-section-recent list all render.

Public embed /api/w/cTxlgGYS/demo: bubble/panel render bottom-left (matches saved position=left, computed left:20px), auto-opens in preview mode, tapping 'Text us' shows Name/Mobile number/Message form; filling 5005550123 and clicking 'Send text' transitions to 'Check your phone, we just texted you.' success screen with zero POST requests fired (verified via page.on('request')).
Regression: /more tab (Tools) -> tap 'Leads' folder -> 'Website Widget' tile visible for manager; tapping routes to /admin/website-widget (widgets-header renders).
Regression: /inboxes screen still renders (no error nodes).
